The tools directory contains unmodified FFmpeg and FFprobe executables.
FFmpeg is a separate program invoked by Broken Phone to inspect, convert and mix media.

FFmpeg project and source releases: https://ffmpeg.org/download.html
Upstream source repository: https://git.ffmpeg.org/ffmpeg.git
Windows binary provider: https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/
Build source references: https://github.com/GyanD/codexffmpeg

The actual version, configuration and copyright notice of the bundled executables
are recorded in FFmpeg-build.txt. Their license notice is in FFmpeg-license-notice.txt.
This build is licensed under GNU GPL version 3 or later; see GPL-3.0.txt.
